summary: Phase 2.2 Trust & Delivery re-test after fix to user_to_public(). All 21 tests in test_phase22_trust_delivery.py now PASS (previously 14/21). The fix correctly added verified_driver, profile_photo, and review_count fields to the public user shape. No regressions detected across booking fees, quote estimation, admin deposit bands, and login flows.
seed_data_creation: None - tests use existing seeded admin (admin@cargoone.com/admin123) and dynamically create test drivers/shippers per test class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2.2 Trust & Delivery is fully green. All document upload/review, verified_driver flag logic, public profile, POD, and bid-with-verified-flag flows work correctly. Regression tests for booking fees, quote, and admin deposit bands also pass.
rca_of_issue: Previous failures were caused by user_to_public() omitting verified_driver, profile_photo, and review_count fields. Fix added these fields with verified_driver computed as (role=driver AND documents_verified AND status=active AND total_jobs>=1). Re-run confirms 21/21 pass.
